sources.title: AI Gateway Exploitation: LiteLLM, RAGFlow, Kestra Hit
sources.snippet: LiteLLM is an open-source AI gateway and Python SDK that provides a unified OpenAI-compatible API across more than 100 model providers. It is deployed at thousands of enterprises as the single outbound chokepoint for all LLM traffic, making it the highest-value target in the AI infrastructure layer.
